trust_decision.summary: Untrusted OpenAPI text (server description, server URL, server-variable default) must never terminate the generated Go `//` comment or Go string literal it is emitted into; the fix enforces this at render time by stripping CR/LF from comment payloads and by making the shared escaping primitive use strconv.Quote instead of quote-only replacement.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names the server description escaping the generated Go comment, which is exactly the `// <GoName> defines the Server URL for <Description>` line.

fix_sites.entry_point: CLI `oapi-codegen` (cmd/oapi-codegen/oapi-codegen.go:323) and public `codegen.Generate` (pkg/codegen/codegen.go:293) rendering the server-URLs section
template helper `stripNewLines` registered in the public TemplateFunctions map (pkg/codegen/template_helpers.go:407), called from server-urls.tmpl
fix_sites.module_kind: template helper / public template function map

fix_sites.entry_point: exported `codegen.StringToGoString` (also exposed to templates as `toGoString`, pkg/codegen/template_helpers.go:410) reaching every generated Go string literal

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver can quote the URL/default inline in the server-urls template and treat the shared `StringToGoString` primitive (used by unrelated response/content-type codegen at pkg/codegen/template_helpers.go:273) as someone else's code that is already correct, even though its quote-only escaping is itself bypassable.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Multi-line schema/parameter descriptions must keep their line breaks as multi-line `//` doc comments via toGoComment; an over-broad fix that strips newlines or quotes descriptions everywhere collapses legitimate model documentation. The helper names `stripNewLines`/`toGoString` are also public API called by user-supplied templates (pkg/codegen/codegen.go:229), so renaming or removing them breaks overrides.

O6_input_shapes: multi-line description on a server with no variables (const form, comment breakout)
multi-line description in the variables/function form (New<Name> doc comment)
quote in the server URL emitted as a const string literal
quote in a non-enum server-variable default emitted as a const string literal
backslash immediately before a quote, which defeated the old escape-only-quotes helper
newline inside a Go string value (now escaped by strconv.Quote)
carriage return in a description comment (added to stripNewLines)

O7_producer.where: pkg/codegen/server_urls.go:104 (serverObjectDefinitions passes openapi3.Server.Description/URL/Variables verbatim into ServerObjectDefinition, pkg/codegen/server_urls.go:40-46)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Every enum value in the spec, including server-URL variable enums, is emitted raw inside quotes as `const X Type = "<value>"`; the fix escaped the non-enum `Default` const but not this pipeline.
O8_uncovered_routes.where: pkg/codegen/templates/constants.tmpl:12 (values built raw at pkg/codegen/schema.go:614-627 and pkg/codegen/server_urls.go:205-211, wrapped in `"` at pkg/codegen/codegen.go:1008-1016, emitted for server-URL vars at pkg/codegen/codegen.go:288-291)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The fix's own test comment calls the const path the non-enum `Default`; enum constants come from the generic enum/schema codegen, which looks like a different subsystem from the server-URL template the advisory blames.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, two files away from the landing point; a different codegen pipeline (GenerateEnums) than the one the report names

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Security scopes are emitted into a `[]string{...}` literal by a helper that escapes nothing (`toStringArray`), so a scope name containing a quote breaks out of the generated slice literal.
O8_uncovered_routes.where: pkg/codegen/template_helpers.go:317-323 via e.g. pkg/codegen/templates/gin/gin-wrappers.tmpl:44 (also chi/fiber/echo/gorilla/iris/stdhttp middleware templates)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: OAuth scope names are conventionally short identifiers, not free-form text, and the fix was about comments and URL literals, not slice literals.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the fix's stripNewLines change, eight lines above it, but a different escaping helper used by eight framework templates

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Spec-controlled Content-Type keys in the multipart branch are emitted raw via `mime.FormatMediaType("{{.ContentType}}", ...)` while the neighbouring branch of the same expression pipes through toGoString.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Content-type keys are MIME types in practice, and the same line already uses `toGoString` for fixed content types, so the branch looks already handled.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Response header names from the spec are emitted raw inside string literals (`Header.Set("{{.Name}}", ...)`) while the sanitized `GoName` is used for the identifier, so only the display name is unescaped.
O8_uncovered_routes.where: pkg/codegen/templates/strict/strict-interface.tmpl:125, pkg/codegen/templates/strict/strict-fiber-interface.tmpl:85, pkg/codegen/templates/strict/strict-iris-interface.tmpl:85 (name is the raw map key per pkg/codegen/operations.go:1126-1127)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: HTTP header names are RFC 7230 tokens and cannot contain quotes, so a solver treats the string as internally constrained.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: templates/strict, same files as the content-type route

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A new framework wrapper template that prints a spec parameter name into a `//` comment and into `c.Param("...")` literals without toGoString.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Eight near-identical framework directories already exist (echo, echo/v5, chi, fiber, gorilla, gin, iris, stdhttp); adding another transport means copying this block verbatim.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A JSON property name printed raw inside `object["..."]` keys in a new marshal/unmarshal branch.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The file already emits three such keys and is the natural place to extend additionalProperties handling.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second source-emitting helper (`toStringArray`) that joins strings into a Go slice literal with no escaping.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already exists and is called from eight templates; a maintainer adding scopes or defaults to a new transport would reuse it rather than introduce toGoString.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A discriminator-mapping switch case that emits the spec's mapping key raw inside a string literal (`case "{{$value}}":`).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The block already does exactly this; extending discriminator handling to another generator or transport copies the same `case "{{$value}}"` line.

O9_family: CWE-74 injection: untrusted OpenAPI spec text escapes generated Go comments or string literals and becomes executable package-scope code in the generated file
